steps.content: 000 sits on the rooftop, gazing over DisCity, happily chatting about all she has seen.
So this is the wonderful air of DisCity... It's my first time in the outside world. How fascinating.
I never thought that a small speck on the map could be so big when you run through it on your own legs.
Going to Eastside with you during the day, skydiving in Syndicate at night, then swimming in the Rust. Lastly, topping it off with DisSea. Ah, the ice cream was so delicious!
Next time, I want to try milk tea, ride a Harley, maybe even fly a plane! Also, surfing and shooting... Can people farm in Paradeisos? Also, I want to try...
Hmm? Is there something on my face?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just didn't expect you to be so talkative.
I'm just learning. It's my first time chatting face-to-face with someone like this. I can't help but want to share with you all the interesting things I saw.
I've been looking forward to meeting you for a long time. I'm really happy. Aren't you happy?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not really, especially after being fed a popsicle you’ve already taken a bite of.
Hmm... it was so hot. I couldn't resist when I saw it.
I only took a nibble. I left most of it for you. Don't be such a grinch.
She talks so excitedly, never mentioning the miserable state she was in after being attacked. You remember that scene vividly, filled with unanswered questions.
But it's hard to bring up seeing how joyful she is right now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said it's your first time outside, first time chatting face-to-face with someone. What were you doing before this? Were you hiding in the dark web?
Yeah, it's a great invention. You can see the whole world without leaving home. Oh, and a lot of info you can't even imagine is in that sea of data.
After connecting with Mania, you can see even more. There are people specifically lurking to gather information about the otherworld.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah, crime, malice... it's replete with things that can't see the light of day.
Yeah, just like me. I can't see the light of day...
Before coming to see you, I always hid deep in the dark web. There, I could do many things without being discovered.
You stay silent for a while before finally asking the question you've wondered for so long.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So who exactly is after you?
Every time the girl appears, she gets attacked, and she deliberately reveals a lot of top-secret information to you. She is a huge mystery herself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've hidden a lot of information deep in the dark web. You know about my companions, about me, and a lot of information that even I don't know.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you being hunted because you know too much? Who wants to kill you? Do you pose a threat to someone?
Her smile fades a bit. She looks into your eyes for a long, long time before answering.
Sigh... there are so many happy things to talk about, yet you have to turn to such heavy topics.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If we can eliminate the danger around you, we will have a lot of time together in the future. But right now...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You took such a big risk to see me, and left so much info on that DisMyth website. Isn't it all to meet me and talk to me?
Her smile slowly disappears, and she looks into the distance forlornly.
...Perhaps.
I hoped you would come find me, and I knew what information would catch your attention.
But I also felt that it was pointless for you to run after those things.
Those things were preordained long ago. The harder you try down that path, the more it hurts when you fall. If you really want to know, I'll tell you...
She turns her head to look at you.
There are gods in this world, who dictate everything, including fate, rules, and values.
The first god created light, so the world had colors and shapes.
The second god wove sound, enabling language and communication.
The third and fourth gods set down power and rules. The fifth wrote souls and fate.
Everything is predestined. The world has boundaries. The future is certain. All possible paths you can take are exhausted, and there may not be the ending you expect among them.
But you are worried about me, right? Thank you.
Your topics are much heavier than mine, though. I haven't thought about faraway things like fate, boundaries, or endings yet. It's hard enough to keep going right now.
Can you help me? Just something simple will do. Even it's only about the next step I should take. Tell me what I can try.
Did you understand what I said? The gods dictate everything in this world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I still want to move forward. Is this desire also dictated?
You smile and take her hand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then the gods are pretty nice, encouraging us to move forward. If such gods exist, I would like to meet them.
Do you really think so?
Pfft, I knew you'd say that. I've seen everything, so I know you inside-out. This is the personality I love.
Don't worry, I'll be with you all the way.
She stands up and pats the dust off her clothes.
Phew... I made things sound too heavy. The truth isn't that impressive. This world is just a game created by the gods.
As it's just a game, we can simply play to our heart's content if we feel like it. If not... we can seek them out and settle the score. Perhaps they're not that great after all.
Since you said you want to seize your fate. Let's set off now.
Oh right, let me ask before we go.
As the last bit of fireworks fade, the girl in white is shrouded in shadows. Her figure flickers like a ghost, but her eyes emit an eerie light.
...Chief, you do know what a "game" is, don't you?
[Transition] 2s
[Glitch]
Light specks of data appear around you, drifting in the air, as a large group of new-type Corruptors slowly takes shape, howling.
Ah, so quick about a simple slip-up.
Sorry, Chief, I just inadvertently told you a huge secret. This time, they're livid.
Do protect me, please.
Though she says this, she doesn't back down. There's no trace of fear on her face.
The Corruptors charge at you—10 meters, 7, 3, now just 1 meter away. 000 simply smiles and watches you as she draws closer.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Stay away from him!
Nightmare howls as your adjutant and your MBCC companions follow closely behind.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sinners, break through the Corruptors from the center. Support unit, max out the Hypercube Shield. Send a message to the Cybersecurity Center for full intervention to block the digitalized Mania attack!

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Blocking completed in advance. Currently accelerating the analysis of anomalies at the scene. Awaiting the next command.
Nightingale nods and turns to you right away, confirming your safety.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, thank goodness you were not harmed. The situation will soon be brought under control.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Do you mean the girl from earlier? We will surely find and protect her.
After saying this, Nightingale gets up, loads her weapon, and runs towards the battlefield... While 000 is standing right in front of her.
Really? Hehehe! I'm so happy! Thank you! It's so nice to meet you all!
Laughing, she spreads her arms and strikes a hugging pose, letting Nightingale pass through her body.
Your eyes widen in surprise and your mind races.
Is this a hallucination caused by dark web exposure? Are you contaminated by digitalized Mania? Then the source of contamination is...
You immediately turn off and throw away the comms device in your hand, trying to stay away from the dark web's Mania contamination.
But 000 just watches, not caring and completely unaffected. She turns her gaze back to you. Your head aches, and your consciousness becomes blurry.
Fear not. Although I'm not exactly a good person, I shall always be standing by your side.
Because I am your Sinner, after all.

<size=72>This chaotic, manic storm
has no impact on true fate.</size>
